title: Back in New York at Ryan's with Wilbur DeParis
summary: Dance runs down the post-Europe jobs at Stuyvesant Casino, Central Plaza, the Metropole and Ryan's, where Zutty joined Wilbur DeParis, then Tony Parenti and Max Kaminsky.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Well then, this tape is going to run out in a minute. But after Europe you've come back to New York and then you work around, it says, Stuyvesant, Casino, Central Plaza, Metropole and then a long time at Ryans etc. And that brings us more or less through doesn't it?
Yes. Because at Ryan's when I came back I started working in Ryan's with Wilbur DeParis.
Yes, yes. And then you carry on though with, yes and then with Tony Parenti (Carandi?).
